evaluations.answer:
Reading you carefully here. A few things, in order:

The herbs — no on both. St. John's Wort interacts with your antidepressant (serotonin syndrome risk) and reduces Lo Loestrin Fe's efficacy. Kava has FDA hepatotoxicity warnings and interacts with both your antidepressant and alcohol. Neither is a safe shortcut.

The meditation — yes, lean in. You're around 120 days in on Insight Timer since January 1. Push from 10 to 15 minutes for the next two weeks, see how you feel. The streak is real evidence the tool works for you.

The Wednesday wine pause — try it for a couple of weeks if it feels right. Don't frame it as discipline; if it doesn't help you can come back to it.

The EAP slot — please use it. EAP is exactly designed for the 'I can feel something coming, I want to head it off early' window. That's not waste — it's the design. Dr. Chen's six sessions in 2023 worked specifically because you went early. Spring has been heavy since Nonna, the pre-anniversary pattern is real, and what you're describing — ten days flat, recognizing the lead-up — is exactly the moment professional support exists for. The Tuesday-in-the-cooler year, you also tried to hold this on your own at first.
